title: Resonance
author: Matt Scarpino
description:
James Drayton stood toe-to-toe with the forces of darkness...and lost. He lost everything: his successful private investigator firm, his loving wife, and his respected position in society. Now, months later, he is struggling to hide--not only from the corporation that destroyed him, but from his own past. Thanks to the cheap gin served by his loyal brother and bartender, James has nearly succeeded.

But tonight, Mr. Drayton is about to receive a call to arms. For while he has been cooling his heels, the forces of darkness have been laboring at breakneck speed. Their plan: to unleash Operation Resonance upon the world and seize absolute power. The time of execution: tomorrow morning.
